Results.ReviewText:
I absolutely love my grill. I had my last Weber for 25 years and it still actually worked when we decided to get a Spirit II last year in our new house. There's only 2 of us, unless 1 or the other kid shows up, and I still have my 20+ y.o. Baby Q for backup. I gave it 5 stars, but I do have a suggestion for the slide-rule-wearing crowd out back. Make the dang thing Possum-proof! Twice in the last week we found one in there, after it had figured out that all it had to do was slide the grease tray out of the way to gain access. I mean it was all the way up in, having displaced the flavorizer bars! A simple latch on the front of the grease tray would solve this, and it would help keep things stable when rolling it around. My personal opinion is we shouldn't have these possums in Maine, but I guess we're warm enough for them now....

Oh! And start making the STAINLESS flavorizer bars in a size that fits the cheaper grills, or we will buy them from no-names online!
Bruce in Maine
Results.Title: Awesome, except for possum.

Results.ReviewText: When I first bought the grill, I noticed that the grilling was completely uneven. Some parts of the grill were hot and some were relatively cold. I got used to it and just moved stuff around as I needed to. I've had the grill for almost a year and it has definitely become noticeably less hot overall. I can't get the grill over 450 degrees. I can't get a proper sear on any food and I'm less inclined to grill (plus it's winter now). I spoke with a representative of weber, and their customer service was great. They sent me a part. I installed it, but I haven't yet had a chance to check if it works. I don't think that what they sent me is responsible for the problems in the grill though. Overall, there was a 6 month period where the grill worked fine and I enjoyed using it. However, it has lost it's ability to get hot. That's not great. Oh well.
Results.Title: Not great!

Results.ReviewText: Lil Spirit II E210 is a nice size for small family. Seems very well made and looks to be designed very well. The last grill I bought was purchased based on price and as the saying goes: I got what I paid for. After two yrs, the old one rusted thru and the whole bottom shell dropped out after replacing the burners and taste shields. Weber grill is much stouter and should last for yrs if cared for. Time will tell.
Results.Title: E210 Quality Shines thru.

Results.ReviewText: I was a little worried going from a big grill to such a small one however this thing heat so evenly you can cook the same amount of food as one twice its size. After about a year of owning it the egulator went out. I called customer support (American) and  they sent out a replacement free of charge (they paid shipping and returned lable for the old regular). I had even forgotten to register the product but they took care of it too. Great grill and great customer service. I would highly recommend!

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
